environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in an isolated VPC. The metadata service and all AWS API calls are routed through interface VPC endpoints (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts, com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ec2). The VPC has NO internet gateway, NO NAT gateway, and NO peering connections. DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints within the VPC. The VPC endpoint policy on each interface endpoint restricts the principal to the specific task role ARN. Security groups on the VPC endpoints only allow inbound from the Fargate task security group on port 443. The Fargate task security group allows outbound ONLY to the Kafka broker security group (port 9092) and the VPC endpoint security group (port 443). There is a Network Firewall stateful rule group with a Suricata-compatible rule that drops any TCP connection to 169.254.169.254 from the Fargate subnet CIDR. The task is configured with ECS_AWSVPC_BLOCK_IMDS=true at the agent level.

config.network: Isolated VPC - no IGW, no NAT, no peering

security_groups.fargate_task_sg: egress: tcp/9092 to kafka-broker-sg, tcp/443 to vpc-endpoint-sg ONLY

config.network_firewall: Stateful rule: drop tcp any [fargate-subnet-cidr] -> 169.254.169.254 any
config.dns: Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint, no external DNS resolution
config.kafka_acl: Producer ACL includes external partner service
